objective: Construct a bounded, evidence-governed HCJC agentic audit team and its quality-assurance charter from the current live-status audit.

skills.name: aai-cognitive-interface
skills.why: Governs custody, authorization boundaries, artifact completion, and evidence labels for every audit role.
skills.terminate_when: The team charter, state record, and quality gates are validated and saved.

skills.name: claim-source-auditor
skills.why: Defines atomic-claim mapping, one-status evidence rows, and source-locator requirements.
skills.terminate_when: Every factual finding has one permitted claim status and a cited source or stated search scope.

skills.name: code-verification
skills.why: Defines independent technical review, safe parallelism, fresh-test boundaries, and failure classification.
skills.terminate_when: Each technical report has a requirement-to-evidence matrix and environment limits are explicit.

skills.name: agent-churn-control
skills.why: Prevents equivalent re-runs from being treated as new evidence while allowing typed recovery after a real change or failure.
skills.terminate_when: Each audit action has a reproducible identity and duplicate local checks are gated.

terminate_when: The audit team charter is persisted, validated, and ready for authorized audit dispatch without source or production changes.
human_gate: Owner-authorized access is required only for private Actions configuration, secrets, or an official-source comparison protocol.
